split_definitions.train: Curated, rights-cleared trajectories and code examples permitted for model training.
split_definitions.dev: Open validation split used for prompt engineering and iterative evaluation during development.
split_definitions.eval_private: Held-out private benchmark tasks strictly isolated from training corpora and candidate access.
split_definitions.eval_public: Public benchmark tasks used for external reproducibility and community evaluation.

provenance_rules: Every source must specify source identity, revision, rights holder, exact license, intended uses, and evidence reference.
Public availability or open repository hosting does not imply training clearance; license must explicitly permit commercial model training.
Internal authorship claims without independent copyright assignment or legal clearance must default to REVIEW_REQUIRED.
Unreal Engine proprietary source code, starter content, and Epic marketplace assets are strictly PROHIBITED from training corpora.
Unity engine source and Asset Store assets are strictly PROHIBITED from training corpora.
Private evaluation benchmark tasks, hidden grader oracles, and reference solutions are strictly RESTRICTED_EVAL_ONLY and prohibited from training.
All secrets, API tokens, passwords, and PII must be scrubbed before ingestion.
